title: Fairly heavy rainfall expected in parts of the island today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Northern provinces and in Galle and Matara districts, today (18), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Oil touches 2-week high after drone attack on UAE nuclear power plant
byline: Oil prices extended gains on Monday as efforts to end the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran appeared to have stalled, after a nuclear power plant in the United Arab Emirates came under attack and as U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to discuss military options on Iran.

title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship due to arrive at Rotterdam port as final destination
byline: The hantavirus-hit cruise ship MV Hondius was due to dock in Rotterdam on Monday morning for disinfection, with Dutch authorities preparing quarantine arrangements for the 25 crew members and two medical staff remaining on board.

title: Sri Lanka marks 17 years since the defeat of three-decade terrorism
byline: Today (18) marks 17 years since the defeat of the brutal LTTE terrorism that plagued Sri Lanka for more than three decades.

title: Trump warns ‘clock is ticking’ for Iran as peace progress stalls
byline: US President Donald Trump has warned Iran the "clock is ticking" as talks to bring the war to an end have stalled.

title: Chinese national arrested with stock of foreign cigarettes in Kollupitiya
byline: A foreign national has been arrested in Kollupitiya, near Nimalka Gardens, with 540 sticks of foreign cigarettes allegedly brought into Sri Lanka illegally.

title: ‘National Victory Day Commemoration Ceremony’ to be held tomorrow under the patronage of President
byline: The ‘‘National Victory Day Commemoration Ceremony,’’ marking 17 years since the defeat of terrorism, is scheduled to be held tomorrow (19) as in previous years.

title: Nepali Sherpa scales Mount Everest for a record 32nd time
byline: A renowned Nepali Sherpa guide scaled Mount Everest for the 32nd time on Sunday, an official said, smashing his own record set last year.

title: Sri Lanka tourism earnings drop in April, CBSL reports
byline: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) has stated that the total tourism earnings for April 2026 amounted to USD 157.1 million.

title: Fighter jet crews parachute safely after collision at US air show
byline: Four crew members are in stable condition after two fighter jets collided mid-air during a US air show, officials say.

title: Uni students agree to vacate Malwana residence after talks with PM
byline: Following successful discussions with the Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya today (18), a group of university students has agreed to vacate the disputed Malwana residence they had occupied since May 01, according to Ada Derana reporter.

title: Suspect sustains gunshot injury after scuffle with police during arrest in Ampara
byline: A shooting incident has been reported in the Ampara Police Division during a police operation to arrest an individual involved in an illicit liquor racket.

title: Two Sri Lankan passengers arrested with over 14kg of ‘Kush’ at BIA
byline: Two Sri Lankan passengers have been arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) with a consignment of ‘‘Kush’’ narcotics valued at over Rs. 140 million.

title: Adverse weather damages 200 houses, affects over 5,200 people across the country
byline: The Disaster Management Centre (DMC) says that 200 houses have been partially damaged so far due to the prevailing adverse weather conditions.
